description: A script to analyze and process HTTP performance logs, including functions to parse, augment, and bucketize log data related to network performance measurements.

methods.name: resets()
methods.description: Reads a log file specified via command-line argument, extracts timestamps where the last element of lines equals 'SIGNAL_STRENGTH', and returns a list of these timestamps.

methods.name: augment()
methods.description: Reads a log file, processes 'Pulled' lines to compute relative times, and outputs augmented log lines with time differences.

methods.name: chew()
methods.description: Analyzes 'Pulled' lines from the log to compute total transfer time, bytes transferred, and rate; buckets data by time intervals; and applies smoothing for output.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Entry point that calls the 'chew' function to perform analysis.
